target.title: fix: stop doctor misreporting trusted-proxy gateways as unauthenticated
target.body:
Fixes #91284.

## What Problem This Solves

`openclaw doctor` reports a complete non-loopback `gateway.auth.mode="trusted-proxy"` deployment as “without authentication” and recommends token repair even though token and trusted-proxy modes are mutually exclusive.

The result is both inaccurate and operationally harmful: it trains operators to distrust Doctor and can steer a valid identity-aware reverse-proxy deployment toward a configuration the Gateway refuses to start.

## Why This Change Was Made

Doctor now recognizes trusted-proxy authentication only after the configuration satisfies the Gateway’s existing startup and request-authorization contracts. The implementation reuses resolved auth, startup validation, HTTP authorization, trusted-source checks, and browser-origin matching rather than creating a second permissive auth policy.

The downgrade remains fail-closed:

- proxy sources must be canonical usable host addresses: exact IP, `/32`, or `/128`;
- invalid, broad, loopback-disallowed, or host-interface sources remain `CRITICAL`;
- missing or invalid identity headers, unusable allowlists, and mixed shared-token auth remain `CRITICAL`;
- missing, wildcard, loopback-only, or dangerous browser-origin configuration remains independently `CRITICAL`;
- Tailscale/custom-bind and active non-exec SecretRef startup failures remain `CRITICAL`;
- default Doctor never executes an active exec-backed SecretRef provider. It reports startup auth as unverifiable and requires explicit `--allow-exec`; that option is threaded through both lint and normal Doctor paths.

This changes Doctor classification and remediation only. Runtime authentication, config/schema, defaults, protocol behavior, and stored data are unchanged.

## User Impact

- A complete host-scoped trusted-proxy deployment receives a specific exposure `WARNING` plus proxy/firewall guidance instead of a false unauthenticated `CRITICAL`.
- Unsafe, incomplete, or startup-invalid configurations retain specific `CRITICAL` findings.
- An exec-backed active auth SecretRef is never invoked by default Doctor. With `--allow-exec`, Doctor performs the real startup auth preflight.

## Evidence

Control base: current `main` @ `e24420bc1c085d54e375c355ee18a49916a9dc2f`  
Exact PR head: `9680b68d68d4e230421fd6fe361a3677a891b1e6`

All live runs used Node v24.18.0 and the source CLI entry used by `pnpm openclaw`. Every invocation ran from a neutral cwd with `env -i`, a fresh temporary `HOME`, a fresh `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`, and only synthetic `example.com` identities plus RFC 5737 documentation IPs. No credentials, live config, keyring, hostname, home path, or private-network values were available to the process.

![Exact-head before/after and exec-provider proof](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/veteranbv/openclaw/pr-91268-assets/doctor-trusted-proxy-exact-head.gif)

[MP4 proof](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/veteranbv/openclaw/pr-91268-assets/doctor-trusted-proxy-exact-head.mp4)

### Live 13-case result matrix

Command per case:

```shell
openclaw doctor --lint --json --only core/doctor/security
```

| Case | Revision / flag | Primary result | Exec marker |
|---|---|---|---|
| Complete trusted-proxy config | `main` | `CRITICAL ... without authentication` plus incorrect token repair | absent |
| Same complete config | PR head | trusted-proxy `WARNING` plus proxy/firewall guidance | absent |
| Missing explicit Control UI origin | PR head | `CRITICAL` browser-origin finding plus trusted-proxy warning | absent |
| Doctor-seeded loopback-only Control UI origins | PR head | `CRITICAL` missing non-loopback proxy-origin finding plus trusted-proxy warning | absent |
| Wildcard Control UI origin | PR head | `CRITICAL` any-origin finding plus trusted-proxy warning | absent |
| Empty `gateway.trustedProxies` | PR head | startup-validation and readiness `CRITICAL`s | absent |
| Documentation-range `/24` proxy CIDR | PR head | non-host-scoped proxy `CRITICAL` | absent |
| Shared token mixed with trusted-proxy | PR head | mutually-exclusive auth `CRITICAL` | absent |
| Tailscale Serve with LAN bind | PR head | final-config-validation error | absent |
| Custom bind to unavailable documentation IP | PR head | startup-validation `CRITICAL` | absent |
| Unresolved env password SecretRef | PR head | startup-validation `CRITICAL` with redacted ref | absent |
| Exec password SecretRef, default Doctor | PR head | unverifiable startup-auth `CRITICAL`; provider skipped | **absent** |
| Same exec ref with `--allow-exec` | PR head + explicit flag | trusted-proxy `WARNING`; real preflight succeeds | **created** |

<details>
<summary>Representative current-head JSON and marker proof</summary>

Safe trusted-proxy config:

```json
{
  "ok": false,
  "checksRun": 1,
  "checksSkipped": 52,
  "findings": [
    {
      "checkId": "core/doctor/security",
      "severity": "warning",
      "message": "WARNING: Gateway bound to \"lan\" (0.0.0.0) with trusted-proxy authentication configured."
    },
    {
      "checkId": "core/doctor/security",
      "severity": "warning",
      "message": "The Gateway validates each request's proxy source and identity headers; review the deep security audit before exposing this port."
    },
    {
      "checkId": "core/doctor/security",
      "severity": "warning",
      "message": "Ensure only configured trusted proxies can reach the Gateway port; block direct clients at a host firewall, network firewall, or loopback bind."
    },
    {
      "checkId": "core/doctor/security",
      "severity": "warning",
      "message": "Docs: https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/trusted-proxy-auth"
    }
  ]
}
```

Doctor-seeded loopback origins do not prove the remote proxy path:

```json
{
  "markerCreated": false,
  "findings": [
    {
      "severity": "error",
      "message": "CRITICAL: Gateway bound to \"lan\" (0.0.0.0) with Control UI enabled but no explicit browser origin for the non-loopback proxy path that the runtime can match."
    },
    {
      "severity": "warning",
      "message": "Fix: set gateway.controlUi.allowedOrigins to a canonical trusted non-loopback origin without a path or default-port alias."
    }
  ]
}
```

Exec-backed active password ref, default Doctor:

```json
{
  "allowExec": false,
  "markerCreated": false,
  "findings": [
    {
      "severity": "error",
      "message": "CRITICAL: Gateway bound to \"lan\" (0.0.0.0) with startup authentication that Doctor cannot verify without executing a configured secret provider."
    },
    {
      "severity": "warning",
      "message": "Gateway startup auth readiness could not be verified because an active exec SecretRef was skipped."
    },
    {
      "severity": "warning",
      "message": "Fix: rerun Doctor with --allow-exec to verify the provider before exposing this port."
    }
  ]
}
```

The same ref with explicit `--allow-exec`:

```json
{
  "allowExec": true,
  "markerCreated": true,
  "findings": [
    {
      "severity": "warning",
      "message": "WARNING: Gateway bound to \"lan\" (0.0.0.0) with trusted-proxy authentication configured."
    }
  ]
}
```

</details>

### Verification receipts

- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` — clean
- `oxfmt --check --threads=1` on all seven changed files — clean
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/commands/doctor-security.trusted-proxy.test.ts src/commands/doctor-security.test.ts src/flows/doctor-core-checks.test.ts` — **129 passed, 0 failed** across two shards
- New exec-ref regressions applied to pre-fix `007f109693d8` — **2 failed as expected**; exact head — **2 passed**
- New loopback-only-origin regression applied to prior head `2c1d353f1b2a` — **1 failed as expected**; exact head — **1 passed**
- `pnpm check:changed -- <all seven changed files>` — passed core/core-test typechecks, format, lint, dependency/API/plugin-boundary guards, database/media/sidecar guards, webhook/pairing guards, and zero runtime import cycles
- MP4/GIF — 1400×900, 569 decoded frames each; representative frames reviewed for timing, signal, and privacy
- MP4 SHA-256: `2f31a96616d5cedecf1ccf84e0a803e56be8a73e6284c9fa63f12807f7016a62`
- GIF SHA-256: `887c2731395e667e1072434faad20f7f15593851fb21ae299ba93a6d5517e240`
- Exact-head hosted CI — all selected checks completed with no failures; `openclaw/ci-gate` passed at `9680b68d68d4e230421fd6fe361a3677a891b1e6`.

## Test Plan

- [x] Complete trusted-proxy configuration: false unauthenticated `CRITICAL` before, accurate `WARNING` after
- [x] Missing/wildcard/loopback-only origin, empty/broad proxies, and mixed-token auth remain `CRITICAL`
- [x] Tailscale and custom-bind startup failures remain errors/`CRITICAL`
- [x] Unresolved non-exec SecretRef remains a redacted startup `CRITICAL`
- [x] Default Doctor skips exec provider and fails closed as unverifiable
- [x] `--allow-exec` runs the real provider preflight
- [x] Focused tests, formatting, diff hygiene, and changed-surface gate
- [x] Exact-head hosted CI

Boundary: the live evidence proves Doctor CLI classification/remediation and startup-auth execution gating. It does not claim a live remote reverse-proxy/browser login flow.
